duration.text: The E-commerce at Nanchang Hangkong University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport ;2.Application form ;3.High school transcripts ;4.High school graduation certificate;5.Self-introduction video ( 3-5 minutes ):Self-introduction (age, family background, education background, personality, hobbies)Why do you choose to study this major ?Why do you choose to study in Nanchang Hangkong University ?How do you spend your four years in China ?Documents needed for applying for JW202 form:6.two inch photo (photo of passport);7.physical examination form;8.non-criminal record;9.Proof of bank deposit.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health.2. Education background and age limit:Applicants for undergraduate program must have senior high school diploma with good academic performance and be under the age of 22.3.Obey the relevant laws of the PRC and meet the admission requirements of the host universities.4. Applicants must have a good academic record and merits.
